title: Atomic major persona bundles
goal: Selecting one major persona changes its identity, baseline behaviour, and baseline staging lines together for the next answer, while reply profiles remain orthogonal overlays.
scope: Introduce a manifest-backed, bundle-by-directory persona configuration with fixed component filenames
Load and swap immutable persona runtime snapshots atomically
Preserve SQLite, PERSONA_PATH, and legacy filesystem compatibility without a schema migration
Keep reply-profile behaviour and staging overrides distinct and define same-name Nazupi compatibility
Update portal/API presentation, tracked templates, migration documentation, and focused tests
nonGoals: Changing code-owned scheduler, grounding, privacy, or boss-knowledge policies
Changing the SQLite schema or rewriting member reply-style rows
Editing or disclosing live deployment-private prompt contents
Removing legacy-layout support in the same release
Changing persona or profile files through the portal
constraints: Plan only; implementation is not authorized in this child session
Live config/personas files are deployment-private; only templates and documentation may be tracked
Preserve unrelated user changes in AGENTS.md, bot/chat/agent.py, and tests/test_chat_agent.py
Use Python 3.12 and uv; do not add dependencies

steps.title: Implement the fixed-layout bundle catalog
steps.target: bot/chat/persona_catalog.py, bot/chat/persona.py, bot/chat/progress.py, tests/test_persona_catalog.py, tests/test_chat_persona.py, tests/test_chat_progress.py
steps.action: Add strict manifest and bundle models, safe ID/alias resolution, rejection of every symlink bundle directory/component, complete component loading, a full tracked fallback bundle, and legacy-layout adaptation without allowing manifest component paths.
steps.validation: uv run pytest -q tests/test_persona_catalog.py tests/test_chat_persona.py tests/test_chat_progress.py; all catalog, path-safety including within-root symlinks, alias, fallback, staging, and prompt tests pass

steps.title: Swap one immutable persona runtime per selection and turn
steps.target: bot/chat/agent.py, bot/agent/client.py, bot/api/service.py, bot/api/models.py, bot/api/templates/config.html, bot/__main__.py, tests/test_chat_followup.py, tests/test_portal_config.py, tests/fake_bot.py
steps.action: Preload and validate a complete candidate runtime, persist its canonical ID, atomically replace the active snapshot, and pin both _answer and _ask_instead generation flows to one snapshot threaded through overlay resolution, staging, prompt assembly, tool/model rounds, and trailing reminders.
steps.validation: uv run pytest -q tests/test_chat_followup.py tests/test_portal_config.py tests/test_chat_persona.py tests/test_chat_progress.py tests/test_behaviour_plugins.py; normal answers and rejection follow-ups stay on their entry snapshot across an induced switch, the next generation uses the new complete bundle, and failed selection changes none

steps.title: Preserve DB, environment, API, and CLI compatibility
steps.target: bot/__main__.py, bot/infrastructure/config.py, bot/api/service.py, bot/api/models.py, bot/cli.py, tests/test_chat_config.py, tests/test_portal_config.py, tests/test_cli.py
steps.action: Resolve stored filename values and PERSONA_PATH basenames through manifest aliases, save canonical IDs only on later successful changes, retain legacy mode when personas.yaml is absent, preserve existing persona API fields exactly, add the specified effective/mode/label/issue fields, and make generic CLI config rendering safe for object lists.
steps.validation: uv run pytest -q tests/test_chat_config.py tests/test_portal_config.py tests/test_cli.py; existing persona.md and nazupi.md rows resolve correctly, seeds remain insert-only, additive API field types/semantics hold in manifest/legacy/fallback modes, object lists render safely, bossctl config set persona nazupi sends the canonical string, and no database migration is introduced

steps.title: Publish the new private-config template and migration guide
steps.action: Replace tracked major-persona templates with the fixed bundle layout, include all three complete fallback components in the Docker build context/image while excluding private persona data, document compatibility, and give a content-free Yuuki Sakuna/Nazupi migration recipe that preserves the existing Nazupi reply profile.
steps.validation: Run Ruff, portal CSS generation, the non-Ollama suite, docker build, and an in-image load of the complete tracked example bundle; all checks pass and the image contains non-empty identity.md, default.md, and staging.yaml without private personas

reviewFindings.title: Rejection follow-up snapshot scope was omitted
reviewFindings.detail: Resolved by requiring both _answer and _ask_instead to capture and thread one runtime through the full generation flow, with a switch-during-await test in tests/test_chat_followup.py.

reviewFindings.title: Container fallback packaging was underspecified
reviewFindings.detail: Resolved by adding Dockerfile and .dockerignore ownership and requiring all three tracked fallback components in the build context/image plus in-image loader verification.

reviewFindings.title: Additive API and CLI compatibility schema was vague
reviewFindings.detail: Resolved by fixing exact preserved/new fields and meanings and adding tests/test_cli.py coverage for object-list rendering and persona selection.

reviewFindings.title: Symlink policy allowed multiple interpretations
reviewFindings.detail: Resolved by rejecting every symlink bundle directory and required component, including links whose resolved targets remain inside the persona root or point across bundles.

reviewFindings.title: Workplan structure validated by parent helper
reviewFindings.detail: The schemaVersion 2 helper returned valid=true after the parent review; this establishes structural validity only, not readiness or completion.

notes: The catalog YAML names persona IDs, labels, a single default ID, optional legacy aliases, and optional bare bundle filenames (identity/behaviour/staging); it never contains directory paths.
Manifest mode defaults to personas/<id>/{identity.md,default.md,staging.yaml} with optional per-bundle filename overrides; a complete bundle is the unit of fallback and swap.
Reply profiles live directly under behaviours/ with partial staging overrides in behaviours/staging/; behaviours/profiles/ and behaviour-plugins/ remain readable as legacy fallbacks.
The stale empty identities/ directory was removed; live identities live in personas/<id>/ bundles.
Parent structural validation completed with valid=true; structural validity remains separate from execution readiness and completion.

Manifest options exposed for selection include only bundles whose three required components validate; invalid profile staging overrides are quarantined separately and do not invalidate the major persona bundle.
Live verification 2026-09-06: manifest mode, both yuuki-sakuna and nazupi bundles load with no issues; full non-Ollama suite 3113 passed; Ruff, portal CSS, and Docker build all pass.

Live swap verified in production after restart: Yuuki answers as Yuuki, portal swap to Nazupi answers as Nazupi, swap back answers as Yuuki. Earlier confusion was a rejected swap during the invalid-staging window plus in-memory history drag on self-identity questions.

Fallback bundle renamed personas/example/ to personas/kanade/ and is Kanade-flavoured as the repo default; chat test fixtures use production-size context (16384) since the shipped bundles plus tool schemas exceed the 8192 default.
